package consumer

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/progresshans/godj/examples/article/models"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/orm"
)

type Other struct{}

func AssignTerminalResultToWrongModel(ctx context.Context, querySet orm.QuerySet[models.Article]) error {
	article, _, err := querySet.First(ctx)
	var other Other = article
	_ = other
	return err
}
